Aisha (CSM): Quick flag 12Fox (mid-market, ~60 seats) dropped active seats by ~35% in the last month. Renewal in 22 days. Proposing a 'mini-save corridor': 7-day quick enable + 48h infra trial + optional 1-month downgrade window. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Tom (AE): I can do an executive reset call Thu 9am PT. Need a one-liner on expected token savings if we enable caching.

Nina (SE): Their Dedicated cluster has prefix_cache=false and small batching. 48h canary should show impact. Quick steps: enable prefix cache on canary, bump batch cap, measure token delta and 95p latency.

Nina (SE): ```
- Canary: prefix_cache=true on pool-9
- Batching: max_batch_tokens=4096
- Monitor: 95p latency, tokens/session, error rate
- Rollback: rb_cache_toggle.sh
```

Hector (CS Ops): I'll add a 1-question pulse after enablement: "Did this immediately reduce friction? (Y/N)" and capture freeform if N. Link: https://go.redwood/pulse-12fox

Pri (Product): If CS can grab 3 example sessions with bad reranker results, we can repro and check model variant matching.

Aisha (CSM): Owners & timeline: Thu exec (Tom)  9am PT, Nina runs 48h canary starting Thu 10am PT, enablement sessions Fri morning, Hector publishes pulse after each session. Commercial: Tom to propose downgrade window language in follow-up.
